description: Sends a DRAFT certified notification to its receivers. Requires: notification_request_create → notificationRequestId, caseFileId and at least one receiver (notification_receiver_add). 403 if it is not DRAFT; 409 if no receiver is READY_TO_SEND, any is INVALID (see notification_receiver_invalid_purge) or the plan's receiver or document cap is exceeded. ASYNC: the status becomes IN_PROCESS; poll notification_request_status until SENT or beyond before calling notification_certificate_get.
name: notification_request_send
